text.tspan: Primitive · A² A3 · funnel role collaboration

1 compact(history) → 2 select(retention) → 3 return(policy) → 4 write(summary) → 5 verify(lineage) → 6 preserve(lineage)
Evidence: 39/41 repositories, 35/36 families; 39 trajectories (18 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: Message count, token budget, oldest-first, protected groups, remote or local.
Negative control: A generic text truncate utility is not compaction without lineage.
